subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: What user-visible context-overflow diagnostic fields should OpenClaw expose when a channel session exceeds the effective model budget?
rationale: The code already logs the requested facts, but exposing session/channel identifiers and exact token/model details in user-visible channel replies is a product and privacy policy choice rather than a purely mechanical fix.

options.title: Expose Redacted Diagnostics
options.body: Show provider/model, effective budget, observed or estimated tokens, overage, and a redacted channel/session label through a shared formatter with regression tests.

options.title: Keep Details Log-Only
options.body: Leave precise token/session details in logs and metadata while improving the visible message only with safer generic recovery guidance.

options.title: Split Visibility From Recovery
options.body: First standardize generic visible overflow guidance, then track richer diagnostics behind a separate maintainer-approved privacy policy item.

recommendation.title: Expose Redacted Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Show provider/model, effective budget, observed or estimated tokens, overage, and a redacted channel/session label through a shared formatter with regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current-history owner across the runner, formatter, sanitizer, and auto-reply paths that must share the policy.
